findings.observation: Lantern2-chain pink and Ribbon2-chain pink/3-chain teal light gather at their lower cleared-cell source regions. Compared with accepted606 third-phase47.496667, candidate phone45.503333 leaves the broad central board darker and emphasizes the actual low source. This is phase/topology comparison, not equal clock time or pixel registration.

A faint horizontal lower-arena cutline is visible in candidate Ribbon phone45.503333 and tablet44.088333/45.621667. The affected material is local and low opacity; it does not form an opaque/full-width shelf, mask a star family, or make observed essential text unreadable. The review does not claim an invisible clipping edge.

Ordinary Square/+5,000, exceptional2 CHAIN/+15,000 and3 CHAIN/+30,000 are distinguishable. Header commits the complete outcome while per-phase cumulative receipt and current/inert figures progress. Current diamonds remain associated with the active figure; previous figures quieten. These are cumulative outcome labels, not three awards to sum.

Uncleared/refilling star silhouettes and families remain readable; no source wash paints the protected score, mode, forecast or guide. Header target and complete observed title/award/component lines fit; native actual normal Full Board ceiling remains distinct from stationary figures and lettering. Rising figures cross the ceiling during transit. SpriteKit refill stars sometimes share the award region, but no sampled title/equation became unreadable; this is not a claim that every transient layer has zero intersection.

Reviewed frames show bright packet heads/tails rising from clear sources toward the existing Lantern/Ribbon scenic receivers, receiver seam response, then retired flight. This supports visible direction and source/result continuity. Sparse movie samples cannot establish every packet's arrival, exact latency, frame pacing or continuous smoothness.

All9 current quiet-tablet screenshots inspected. Actual Settings Calm-on is visible; settled square/line figures and current diamonds remain above the complete ceiling, exact+15,000/+13,000 below the board. Two disjoint simultaneous patterns remain two figures. The scrolled comparison capture exposes complete canonical prose/Last light and Retry/Hint/Finish; absent stars there reflect actual reader scroll. No normal wash/flight is asserted from these quiet stills.

Restored20-point manual Survival screenshot has complete score, forecast3Mint4/5/6, one Rose survivor and intact next controls; no stale receipt. Later ordinary/separate-clear native stills show distinct fresh outcomes. Gesture success, immediate input and save/replay identity belong to the separate native assertions, not screenshot inference.

Continuous Observatory painting and quiet protected HUD roles remain coherent with middle Play concept. Dense actual stars dominate normal tablet board; transient iridescent award/figures are readable without replacing the scenic board with a panel. Phone Lantern guide tail is below the current viewport, an opening reader scroll position; no new truncation defect is inferred.
